digest.component_or_area: plan-review-gate instrumentation and criteria promotion monitoring
propositions: A standing, incremental per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed to monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion without the git-object-walk cost of R7's outcome-corpus approach or per-criterion wiring.

The recorder must compute detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units remediated to later PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction de-escalated via dropped decision without remediation) from sidecar re-review history alone, with zero LLM cost.

The recorder must auto-include every criterion id observed in sidecars (no registration required) and be idempotent (re-runnable without duplication via dedup key ticket+review_ts+round_uuid+norm_id).

The --report output must be deterministic over a trailing window of tickets (by max review_ts) and include sample_counts (denominators) so rates are null rather than fabricated when denominators are zero.
The firing ledger must be prune-immune (append-only, capturing firings before sidecar retention prune) and the committed metrics artifact must demonstrate real signal over the existing corpus.
